questions.question: Anuj and Anup have to travel from a place A to a place B in their respective cars. Anuj is driving at 70 km/h, and takes 3 halts of 10 minutes each, while Anup is driving at 80 km/h, and takes 4 halts of 15 minutes each. The time taken by Anup to reach Place B, if Anuj takes 8.5 hours, is:
questions.solution:
Given

The time taken by Anup to reach Place B = 8.5 hours

Anuj is driving at 70 km/h

Anup is driving at 80 km/h

Formula used

Speed = Distance/time

Calculation

Total halt time of Anuj = 3 × 10 = 30 minutes = 0.5 hours

Actual driving time of Anuj = 8.5 - 0.5 = 8 hours

Total distance = 8 × 70 = 560 km.

Total halt time of Anup = 4 × 15 = 60minutes = 1 hours 

The time taken by Anup to reach Place B = 560 / 80 

= 7 hours

Total time = 7 + 1 = 8 hours.

**The answer is 8 hours.**

questions.question:
In the given figure, diameter AB and chord CD of a circle meet at P. PT is a tangent to the circle at T. If CD = 8 cm, PD = 10 cm and PB = 8 cm, find AB. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/add194e6f3dc157f192598437c67f929ca1fd0ff2942c58e16aa765b3e34df23.png]
questions.solution:
Concept:

Secant Property

If chord AB and chord CD of a circle intersect at a point P, then

PA × PB = PC × PD

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/add194e6f3dc157f192598437c67f929ca1fd0ff2942c58e16aa765b3e34df23.png] 

Let the AB = x

PA × PB = PC × PD

⇒ (8 + x) × 8 = 18 × 10

⇒ (8 + x) = 180/8

⇒ (8 + x) = 22.5

⇒ x = 22.5 - 8

= 14.5

∴ The answer is 14.5.

questions.question: If x + y = 7 and xy = 19, then calculate the value of x² + y².
questions.solution:
Given:

x + y = 7

xy = 19

Formula Used:

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

Calculation:

x + y = 7

Squaring both sides

⇒ (x + y)² = 7²

⇒ x² + y² + 2xy = 49

⇒ x² + y² = 49 - 2 × 19

⇒ x² + y² = 11

∴ The value of x² + y² is 11.

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 12, and (ab + bc + ca) = 47, find the value of (a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc).
questions.solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 12 and ab + bc + ca = 47 

Concept used:

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c) × [(a + b + c)² - 3(ab + bc + ca)]

Calculations:

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 12 × [(12)² - 3 × 47]

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 12(144 – 141)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 12(3) 

⇒ 36

∴ The answer is 36.

questions.question: Anand covers a certain distance in the first lag of 5 hours at the speed of 50 km/h. In the second lag, he increased the speed by 20% due to which he covered 20% extra distance than that of the first lag. He covered the third lag at the average speed of the first two lags and covered 10% extra distance than that of the second lag distance. How much total time (in hours) did he take to complete all three lags?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Time = 5 hours

Speed = 50 km/hr

**Formula used**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation**

Distance = 50 × 5 = 250 km

In the second lag:

Distance = 250 + 250 × 120/100 = 300 km

Speed = 50 + 50 × 120/100 = 60 km/hr

Time = 300/60 = 5 hours

In the third lag:

Distance = 300 + 300 × 110/100 = 330 km

Speed = (60 + 50)/2 = 55 km/hr

Time = 330/55 = 6 hours

Total time = 5 + 5 + 6 = 16 hours

**The answer is 16 hours.**

questions.question:
In the given figure, a circle is inscribed in ΔPQR, such that it touches the sides PQ, QR and RP at points D, E, F, respectively. If the lengths of the sides PQ = 18 cm. QR = 13 cm and RP = 15 cm, then find the length of PD. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bd5afc6c266ec4d67b6bbb01d33174597d53fbbf033640c85c45bb7bd9f4076.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 PQ = 18 cm, QR = 13 cm and RP = 15 cm

**Concept used:**

A pair of tangent lines drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length.

So, PF = PD, DQ = EQ and FR = RE

**Calculation**

Let PD be x cm,

then QD = (18 – x) cm

⇒ QE = (18 – x) cm

⇒ RE = 13 – (18 – x) = x – 5

⇒ RF = (x – 5)

⇒ PF = 15 – (x - 5) = 20 – x

⇒ 20 – x = x

⇒ 2x = 20

⇒ x = 20/2

⇒ x = 10 cm

⇒ PD = 10

**The answer is 10.**

questions.question: A works 3.5 times as fast as B, and A takes 45 days less than B to complete a job when each works alone. Calculate the number of days taken to complete the same job if A and B work together.
questions.solution:
Given

A works 3.5 times as fast as B

A takes less days to complete the work than B = 45

Formula Used

Efficiency = 1/Time [When work is same]

Calculation:

The ratio of efficiency of A and B = 7 : 2

The ratio of time of A and B = 2 : 7

Let us assume the time taken by A and B is 2x and 7x.

The difference in the number of days A and B = 45

⇒ 7x - 2x = 45

⇒ x = 45/5 = 9

So, Total Work = 9 × 14 = 126 units

Work completed by A and B in days = 126/9 = 14 days 

∴ The required answer is 14 days.

questions.question: A sold an article to B at 25% profit and B further sold it to C by earning a certain profit. If the cost price of C is 30% more than the cost price of A, then find the profit percentage earned by B.
questions.solution:
Given:

A sold an article to B at a profit of 25%.

B sold it to C at a profit.

The cost price of C is 30% more than the cost price of A

Concept used:

Profit = S.P. – C.P. (S.P. = Selling price, C.P.= Cost price)

S.P. = C.P. + (C.P. × profit%)

Calculation:

Let A buy the article for Rs.100x

A sold it to B at [100x + (100x × 25%)] = Rs.125x

B bought the article for Rs. 125x

C bought the article for = 100x + 100 × 30/100 = 130x

C's CP = B's SP

Profit earned by B = (130x – 125x) = Rs. 5x

Profit% = 5/125 × 100

= 4%

∴ The answer is 4%.
